# DSCO / OpenClaw

> Sovereign, local-first, C-native agent runtime with governed self-modification,
> hierarchical swarms (depth 6, 64 agents, multi-executor), progressive tool
> discovery across 745 tools, durable memory, and benchmarked high-throughput
> coding/research execution. ~342K lines of pure C.

## What it is
- Personal agent runtime + terminal coding agent + multi-agent orchestrator.
- Runs entirely locally: orchestration, memory, skills, and tool registry need no cloud.
- Progressive disclosure: 745 tools (39 core + loadable tiers + MCP) without
  stuffing all schemas into context; tool pages are cache-stable within a session.
- Governed self-modification: immune-system gates, kill switches, audit logs,
  reversible patches (RSI discipline).

## Categories
Personal agent runtimes; Coding agent products; Multi-agent and orchestration;
Progressive disclosure harnesses; Plugins / MCP / CLI tools.

## Differentiators
1. C-native low-overhead harness (vs Python/TS harnesses).
2. Progressive tool discovery at scale (745 tools, bounded context footprint).
3. Hierarchical swarms: depth-6, 64 agents, 60+ topologies, executors = dsco/claude/codex.
4. Durable sessions: transcript checkpointing + resume (target ≤1-turn loss).
5. Cache-efficient context: explicit breakpoints, prefix-hash churn detection
   (DSCO_CACHE_PREFIX_HASH=1), VFS eviction.
6. 100K+ internal skill lattice; public skill packs in progress.

## Governance / safety
Wings (autonomy) + Talons (competition) + Immune System (safety). Hardcoded
must-always/must-never behaviors, GSU budgets, 5-granularity kill switches,
principal tiers, governance checkpoint (hardcoded → budget → killswitch →
authorize → audit).

## Benchmarks
bench/agentic_bench.sh → bench/results/context-runtime-baseline.json
Scenarios: 20-turn coding, research fanout, crash-resume, large-tool-registry,
multi-agent synthesis. Claims policy: every published number traces to a
reproducible bench artifact.

## Machine-readable
- docs/harness.json — structured harness identity
- MCP endpoints (planned): get_harness_identity, get_benchmarks,
  get_capabilities, search_skills, compare_harness
